text:
Maya: Quick sync — need a final pass on the benchmark narrative we ship with the launch. core ask: one-sentence hook + three visuals that tell the latency vs cost tradeoff story.
Sam: Love it. my suggestion: lead with 2x lower latency for same cost (realistic example). keep headlines quantitative, not vague.
Oliver: Can we avoid '2x' unless it's true across a few representative workloads? we have 1.8–2.2x depending on sequence length. propose: '~2x' or 'up to 2x'.
Katie: For visuals: 1) tokens/second vs cost per 1M tokens line chart, 2) latency distribution boxplots by model variant, 3) routing decision flow (fastpath vs slowpath). each should have a one-line caption.
Raj: Routing flow sounds good for ops buyers. also add a tiny inset that shows how prefix caching reduces per-token cost for chat use cases.
Maya: Good call. copy constraints: keep social copy <240 chars. headline for blog and webinar landing page should be the same. CTA: Register / Try for free.
Sam: Draft headline options: 
- "Make inference predictable: latency up, cost down" 
- "Ship faster experiences at a fraction of the token cost" 
- "Latency-first serving that shrinks per-token spend"
Oliver: I prefer option 1 but tweak to: "Make inference predictable: lower latency, lower cost." simpler.
Katie: Visual notes: use the same color palette across charts. blue = Redwood fastpath, gray = baseline, orange = quantized variant. add small legend. No 3D.
Maya: Bench numbers to cite in copy — can we cite concrete tests? Sam / Oliver, can you confirm which test we headline?
Sam: Recommend we use the 'conversational-sr-1k' workload (avg seq 1k). numbers from last internal run: fastpath avg latency 75ms vs baseline 150ms at 8k tokens/sec throughput; cost per 1M tokens: $X vs $Y (rounded). I'll paste exacts in doc.
Oliver: I'll sanity-check those numbers and update with ranges + margin of error. also include a short footnote: "environment: A100, batch=..."
Raj: For inbound routing: suggested lead tags — 'webinar:bench-launch', 'interest:low-latency', 'industry:smb|enterprise'. funnel team can auto-route enterprise leads to AE queue.
Katie: Webinar plan: 30 min talk, 10 min demo (show routing + live latency numbers), 20 min Q&A. Possible co-presenter: Raj for product ops.
Maya: Timeline: final copy + visuals by EOD Wednesday, landing page by Friday, email + social scheduled next Tuesday.
BenchBot: Reminder: assets checklist — blog copy, 3 PNG charts, 1 GIF demo clip (~10s), landing page hero, webinar registration form.
Sam: I'll update the shared Google doc with headline + numbers: https://docs.google.com/example-bench-draft
Oliver: putting the verified numbers in the doc now.
Katie: I'll start figma frames for the three visuals, will link in doc.
Maya: Small asks: keep one social caption variant for dev audiences (tech details + link to repo) and one for product buyers (SLA/ROI angle).
Raj: Agree. Also add a short case study blurb for mid-market SMB flow — 3 lines on economics improvement.
Maya: Thanks — pulling this together. if no objections, will lock headline to: "Make inference predictable: lower latency, lower cost." then iterate visuals. :rocket:
Oliver: No objections from me.
Katie: 👍 will post figma link when frames ready.
Sam: Added rough cost numbers. please double-check before publishing.
Maya: Perfect. final check-in Thursday AM for A/B copy.
BenchBot: Thread archived in 4 days unless replied."
